# Kimi K2

> > Kimi K2 is an AI assistant platform offering OpenAI-compatible API access to advanced MoE models with 256K context windows, including K2-0905 and multimodal K2.5.

Kimi K2 provides free AI chat capabilities with web search, coding assistance, and writing support. The platform features flexible credit-based pricing starting at $4.99 and developer-friendly API integration compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic formats.

## Key Topics

- Kimi K2 - AI assistant platform with MoE models
- K2-0905 - MoE model with 256K context window
- K2.5 - Native multimodal agentic model with MoonViT
- OpenAI-compatible API - Drop-in replacement for OpenAI endpoints
- Anthropic-compatible - Claude-style API integration
- 256K context - Extended context window for large documents
- MoE (Mixture of Experts) - Efficient model architecture
- API access - REST API with authentication
- AI coding tools - SWE-Bench performance, IDE integration
- Credit-based pricing - Flexible plans from $4.99
- Data security - No training on user data, encrypted chats
- Web search - Real-time information retrieval
- Python SDK - Quick integration examples
- JSON API - Standard REST format
